title: Boys' ADHD symptoms linked to addictive social media use in new study
summary: A new study found correlation between ADHD symptoms in boys and addictive social media use patterns, suggesting potential bidirectional relationship between attention deficits and problematic digital platform engagement.
problem_solved: This research addresses the growing concern about the relationship between mental health conditions like ADHD and compulsive technology use among youth.
why_valuable: The findings contribute to understanding how ADHD may predispose boys to social media addiction, informing parents, educators, and healthcare providers about early intervention strategies.
